# Accepted preparation v2 (additive 0.1.9 candidate)

This pure module checks bounded structure, exact associations and conservative
clock arithmetic. Successful validation authenticates no peer, certifies no owner
fact, installation, retained file or resource hold, and grants no live execution
permission. All fixtures are sanitized synthetic claims. No server owner, schema,
worker journal, HTTP route or host adapter is activated by this package.

The original proposal and source clocks remain immutable history. Timely Accept
links an exact operation/request digest and original no-launch resource hold to a
separate accepted lease. The worker explicitly requests a new bounded no-launch
phase duration in ResourceHold.maximum_preparation_ms; legacy proposal remaining
time remains history and cannot authorize a phase transition by itself. Its maximum lifetime is 120 seconds, further capped by
policy, original inline artifact retention and material retrieval deadlines.
Accepted delivery may arrive after proposal expiry; it cannot retime the proposal.

Prepare requires every original inline artifact and exactly two distinct,
canonical same-transfer source manifest/bundle roles, plus the exact installed
material receipt. Nine unique owner facts cover project, registry, principal,
full chosen harness/CLI/adapter/environment/model configuration, fresh Ready
availability, known budget, full context, the original Git object/policy, and
private material backing. Fact validity is capped by policy at at most 30 seconds.
These remain claims until authenticated owning services verify them. Same-attempt
scoped presence is not a new-admission or global availability fact.

Execution issuance must occur inside the accepted lease. Execution delivery is
independently anchored to the actual sender/receiver monotonic exchange and exact
server execution expiry/hard cap; it is not capped by expired preparation history.
A replay only reduces an existing sampled deadline and cannot revive an expired
sample. DeadlineSample is arithmetic, not an execution permit.

Every document and canonical digest input is capped at 128 KiB. Collections have
explicit finite bounds (including nine unique fact kinds, one material lease,
and original transport artifact limits). Decode checks context-free shape; callers
must additionally call the contextual validate_for methods and perform real owner
authorization/current-fact checks. Exact contract artifact and all three v2
features are mandatory; no automatic legacy fallback exists.

Generate artifacts with `cargo run -p aq-admission --example
export_preparation_v2 -- schema|contract|fixtures`. Independent standard-library
Python vectors: `python3 tools/preparation_v2_vectors.py --check`. Rust tests
check generated drift and every source/artifact byte in the qualified 0.1.8 archive
(the legacy lib.rs is an exact prefix). Existing 0.1.7/0.1.8 archives stay immutable.
The final joint 0.1.9 archive also includes the separately qualified scoped-presence
module; this candidate is not a publication or deployment claim.
